platformClient.retentionBoundary: Harborview owns documents and transcript events. Directiv receives at most ten ordered client-owned events and holds only encrypted, short-lived sequential state.

tools.description: Apply one browser-local patch containing every approved, non-empty registration value the prospective visitor explicitly gave or confirmed in chat. This does not create a patient, registration, intake, hold, or appointment. Never include patient-reported conditions, allergies, medications, or procedures from a PDF or inferred document content; those four values require explicit visitor text confirmation in chat.

tools.description: Find currently available administrative recognition appointment times by specialty. This only browses availability and does not hold or book a time.

parameters.description: Requested Harborview specialty.
Optional time preference.

Recognition specialty requested.

tools.description: Navigate the current Harborview browser session to an actor-authorized internal application view. Use only when the user explicitly asks to open, show, go to, or be taken to a Harborview screen. This only initiates client-side navigation and does not retrieve medical data or modify any record.

parameters.description: Named Harborview view requested by the user. Select only a destination allowed for the current actor lane.

tools.description: Navigate the current Harborview browser session to an actor-authorized administrative record detail view. Use only when the user explicitly asks to see or open a specific record and its exact identifier appeared in a prior authorized Harborview tool result. This only initiates client-side navigation and does not retrieve or modify the record.

parameters.description: Harborview record category to open. Select only a record type permitted to the current actor lane.
Exact Harborview record identifier returned by a prior authorized Harborview tool result. Never invent, transform, or request a record identifier from the user.
